The above table shows the major export destination of Ethiopia at a country level. The values given in the table indicate the percentage share of the earnings from exports to each respective country out of the total export earnings of Ethiopia in specific year. The importance of these countries has been fluctuating over the years, with either Germany or China taking the top rank in all cases. For example, during the year 2005/06, China had been the most important export destination for Ethiopia followed by Germany and Japan. During the year 2006/07, Italy and Saudi Arabia were the second and third major export markets of Ethiopia following Germany. In the year that followed, Saudi Arabia was the second followed by United States of America. Finally, in the latter two years of the period under consideration, China and Germany were the first and the second most important sources of revenue for Ethiopia‟s exports. Netherlands and Somalia were the third major export destinations for the 2008/09 and 2009/10, respectively.
